businessName: Hot and Red Cafe and Restaurant - Patna
whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Hot and Red Cafe and Restaurant,

I noticed your cafe has fantastic 4.6★ reviews from over 950 customers on Boring Road, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for table reservations and food delivery orders.

Maine aapke cafe ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table booking, popular menu items, aur rooftop dining vibe showcase integrate ki hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/hotred

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team Hot and Red Cafe, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp table booking, menu showcase, and your prime location on Boring Road. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact menu items, professional food photography, aur online reservation setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
